PLAN "12-Week Strength Return-to-Ski (Post-Meniscus)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lower-body and core strength with knee-friendly progressions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Base Strength and Tissue Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body A (Knee-Friendly)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body B (Hip Hinge/Core)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
